question: Which of the following components are provided by SAP Business Technology Platform environments? (Choose three.) A. Tools B. Runtime C. Applications D. Systems E. Services
In SAP Cloud Integration, which iFlow element can use a namespace? A. Filter B. Script C. Mapping D. Timer
To subscribe to the Integration Suite service in an SAP BTP trial account, which identifier is required? A. Instance B. App C. Space D. Plan

When you build an iFlow, what can you do to handle errors? A. Use a condition to check status codes B. Place artifacts into a TRY-CATCH subprocess C. Create an exception-handling subprocess D. Implement an exception handler iFlow element

What does the “Open integration" principle of the SAP Integration Suite mean? A. SAP's integration technology portfolio covers all kinds of integration. B. SAP software by default supports any third-party integration. C. SAP software by default supports integrations to other SAP software.
What is used to define reusable composed message structures in a Message Implementation Guideline (MIG)? A. Type Systems B. Complex Types C. Qualifiers D. Simple Types

What information can you provide to the Integration Advisor to enhance the validity of proposals? (Choose three.) A. Location information B. Industry classification C. Workflow role D. Technical context E. Business context

In SAP Integration Advisor, how can you group related information into reusable segments? A. By qualifying nodes B. By assigning codelists to the leaf nodes C. By creating matching groups for nodes D. By providing multiple payload data sets

You want to create an API Proxy for a third-party API but cannot discover any API in the dialog. Which of the following steps might you have forgotten? A. Add an API Provider for Cloud Integration. B. Add an API Provider for SAP Open Connectors. C. Create a Product for the required API. D. Create an API Key policy.

You want to connect a third-party application to an SAP BTP landscape, via an Open Connector provided by the SAP Integration Suite. What must you do first? A. Create a custom implementation for the connector. B. Download the connector artifacts and import them into the SAP Open Connectors. C. Create an instance of the required connector. D. Test the required connector.

What is a connector in SAP Open Connectors? A. A custom-built API integration with a third-party provider B. A pre-built integration flow with a third-party provider C. A custom-built integration flow with a third-party provider D. A pre-built API integration with a third-party provider
What actions can you perform in an SAP BTP trial account? (Choose two.) A. Assign users to a subaccount B. Assign users to a global account C. Create global accounts D. Create subaccounts
In SAP Cloud Integration, which decoding schemes are available to decode a message? (Choose two.) A. Base64 Decoder B. CNN-based Decoder C. GZIP Decompression D. QC-MDPC Decoding

Which of the following does a Message Implementation Guideline (MIG) describe? (Choose two.) A. The mappings between source and target code values B. The meaning of each defined element C. The validation of payloads via XSD D. The structure of a customized interface
What criterion can you use to select fitting mapping proposals? A. Constraints B. Qualified variations C. Confidence score

In the SAP BTP cockpit, what functionality does a destination for Cloud Integration enable? A. Establishing connections between Integration Suite capabilities B. Invoking function modules in on-premise ABAP systems via RFC from cloud applications C. Consuming cloud applications in an on-premise back-end system via HTTP(S) D. Sending e-mails from web applications using public e-mail providers
To test a POST request of APIs in the API Business Hub Enterprise page, what do you need? A. User secret B. Application Key C. Certificate

What are some artifacts that can be added to content packages within the SAP Cloud Integration? (Choose three.) A. Integration Collection B. Script Collection C. Integration Flow D. Workflow E. REST API

You have created an SAP Open Connectors instance and want to create a product from it in API Management. Which sequence of steps must you perform? A. 1. Create an API Proxy 2. Create an API Provider 3. Create a Product B. 1. Create a Product 2. Create an API Provider 3. Create an API Proxy C. 1. Create an API Provider 2. Create an API Proxy 3. Create a Product
Where in SAP Integration Suite Open Connectors can you test connector instances? A. API docs B. Validation C. Resources D. Setup

What are some benefits of value externalization in iFlows? (Choose two.) A. Less memory consumption of iFlows B. Faster run time of iFlows C. Separation of business logic from iFlows D. Simplified portability of iFlows between different tenants
